facts.fact: The circular has taxpayers pay public revenue from e-money wallets run by e-money institutions, which transfer the sum instantly to a payment bank.

Ministerial Circular No. 001 of 18 January 2024 lets banks and e-money institutions collect central-government taxes, duties and fees through digital channels, with banks remitting to the Treasury within 24 hours via the ISYS-Regies software, for DGI, DGDA and DGRAD.
